items.title: 05 November 2026 Short-Term Visiting Scientist positions under the ANRF Prime Minister Professorship Scheme (Rolling Advertisement) Download
items.doc_text:
IIIT Bhubaneswar
Advertisement for Short Term Visiting Scientist 
under an ANRF Prime Minister Professor 
scheme
International Institute of Information Technology Bhubaneswar (IIIT-Bh) was established by  
the Government of Odisha in 2006 and was converted to a unitary University in 2014. It is  
designed to be a premier Institute of Information Technology and related areas. IIIT-Bh aims  
to conduct outcome based higher learning, research, innovation and technology development  
in the field of Information Technology.
IIIT Bhubaneswar invites applications from scholars and professionals for short term assignments as  
Visiting Scientist under the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) Prime Minister  
Professor Scheme at IIIT Bhubaneswar.
Fellowship:
The selected  candidates will be offered a consolidated monthly fellowship ranging from  
₹40,000 to ₹60,000, depending on their qualifications and relevant experience.
Minimum Qualification: Ph.D.
Areas of Specialization:
Ph. D. in the areas of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Data Analytics, 
Atmospheric Science or in related fields.
Maximum Age Limit: 55 years
Tenure of Appointment:
The tenure of appointments is from 3 months to 6 months from the date of his/her joining the 
Institute. 
No. Of positions: Two.
Application Process:
A complete bio-data along with attested copies of all relevant documents should be sent to the 
Director  with  the  superscription  on  the  envelope  “Application  for  Short-Term Visiting 
Scientist under an ANRF Prime Minister Professor scheme’’ to the following address:
 
Director
IIIT Bhubaneswar, 
Gothapatna, Malipada 
Bhubaneswar 751003
A soft copy of the documents may be forwarded to of  fdirector@iiit-bh.ac.in      
Documents Required: 
 Complete bio-data
 Age proof certificate
 Qualification certificates and mark sheets
 Copies of three most important research publications
 Statement of purpose (one page write up showcasing the purpose of applying for this 
position)
 Working experience certificate, if any.
Selection Process:
Applications received will be reviewed by a committee constituted by the Institute. Shortlisted 
candidates will be called for presentation / personal interview, if required.
Note:
 Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained.
 The Institute reserves the right to consider and to fill or not to fill the positions.
 All qualifications must be from UGC recognized University/ Deemed  
University  or  AICTE  approved  autonomous  institution  (wherever 
applicable). The courses offered by autonomous institutions should be 
equivalent to the relevant course approved/ recognized by Association 
of Indian University (AIU).
 No correspondence/queries will be entertained from candidates 
regarding e-mail delays, conduct and result of interview, result of  
interview and reasons for not being called for the research seminar and 
interview.
 Candidates  are  advised  to  visit  the  Institute  website  regularly  for 
updates. Amendments, corrigendum (if any), will be placed on the  
Institute website only.
